verdict: The receptor layer cannot enter J as a validated term: (1) the only receptor-to-percept evidence available is the overlap above; (2) the 1.57x NN-shared-receptor statistic is a ligand-similarity check on 22 pairs (2 hits = 1 mutual pair), not a score; (3) the M2OR model scores (molecule, receptor) activation, and J would need an unvalidated map from activation profile to pleasantness. Any weight on it would be arbitrary, so the receptor claim is dropped from the contribution list.
